product.name: Monolith by Monoprice THX-465IW THX Certified Ultra 3-Way In-Wall Speaker
product.description: Monolith™ by Monoprice™THX‑465IW THX® Certified Ultra In‑Wall SpeakerThe Monolith by Monoprice THX‑465IW THX Certified Ultra 3‑Way In‑Wall Speaker sets a new standard for delivering unrivaled audio performance right in the comfort of your own home. Meticulously engineered to surpass expectations, this speaker series promises an immersive experience that captures every nuance, from the subtlest whispers to the thunderous roars, ensuring an extraordinary auditory journey.Designed to meet the rigorous standards of THX Certification, the THX‑465IW guarantees an optimal frequency response, impeccable dispersion, and minimal distortion. This prestigious certification ensures that the sound emanating from these speakers remains faithful to the original intentions of audio engineers, delivering unparalleled accuracy and precision.At the heart of the THX‑465IW lies a lineup of premium drivers meticulously crafted to excel in their respective frequency ranges. Four 6.5" woofers generate deep, punchy bass that resonates with power, while the 50mm silk dome midrange driver reproduces mid‑frequency details with stunning clarity and realism. Completing the trifecta, a 25mm silk dome tweeter handles high frequencies with finesse, unveiling delicate harmonics and providing a shimmering treble.To ensure seamless integration of these exceptional drivers, the THX‑465IW employs a sophisticated crossover network. This meticulously engineered circuitry expertly divides the audio signal, directing each frequency range to its dedicated driver, resulting in a cohesive and balanced sonic presentation. The result is an audio experience that envelops the listener, transporting them into the heart of the action with unmatched depth and clarity.Installing the THX‑465IW is a breeze, thanks to its heavy‑duty dog legs. These robust mechanisms securely hold the speaker in place, ensuring a stable and vibration‑free performance. Designed for long‑lasting durability, these dog legs provide peace of mind while also facilitating a hassle‑free installation process.Immerse yourself in an audio realm like no other with the Monolith by Monoprice THX‑465IW THX Certified Ultra 3‑Way In‑Wall Speaker. Elevate your home theater experience to new heights as you witness the magic of movies, music, and more come alive with extraordinary precision, detail, and immersion. Revolutionize your audio setup with this pinnacle of in‑wall speaker technology, and discover a world of sound that will captivate your senses like never before.THX® Certified UltraFour 6.5" Woofers50mm Silk Dome Midrange25mm Silk Dome TweeterSophisticated Crossover NetworkHeavy‑Duty Dog Legs THX® CERTIFIED ULTRATested. Approved. Certified.THX® Engineers complete hundreds of different scientifically formulated tests to ensure the highest audio standards possible. Key tests in this program are as follows:Axial Frequency ResponseThis describes a loudspeaker's ability to reproduce audio accurately. Our test confirms the axial frequency response is balanced and flat.Vertical and Horizontal DispersionNot everyone gets the middle seat when watching a movie. So we test the off‑axis response to make sure it is smooth with no audible comb filtering, making every seat in the room the sweet spot.Output Versus DistortionThis test ensures the speaker can reach the high volumes necessary to achieve THX® Reference Level without creating audible distortion or artifacts. PREMIUM DRIVERSHigh Excursion Woofers.Silk Dome Midrange.Silk Dome Tweeter.Featuring carefully selected drivers that deliver a flat frequency response in the listening window, the THX‑465IW features four 6.5" woofers, a 50mm silk dome midrange, and a 25mm silk dome tweeter. The silk dome midrange operates in the 750Hz~3.4kHz range, improving power handling, lowering distortion, and improving the polar response, which allows the speaker to achieve higher SPL. Each 6.5" high excursion woofer features a long fiber pulp cone, NBR surround, and are designed with shorting rings to keep distortion at a minimum. The combined driver design enables the speaker to reach sonic heights and deliver accurate sound for the best in home theater dynamics and detail. PRECISION CROSSOVER NETWORKThe THX® speaker series features carefully selected fourth order Linkwitz‑Riley crossover network acoustic filters. These sophisticated crossovers minimize sonic frequency overlap, reduce distortion, and are an excellent choice to minimize off axis response errors near the crossover frequency. EASY INSTALLThe heavy‑duty dog ear mounting system makes for a fast and problem free installation. The magnetically detachable grille is powder coated in white and can be painted to match any decor. TIMBRE MATCHSame Drivers. Same Soundscape.Monolith™ THX® Certified in‑wall and in‑room speakers utilize the same drivers and crossover components, allowing speakers to be mixed and matched to suit your room! Use in‑wall speakers for the rears and in‑room speakers for the LCR, and you will remain timbre matched across the Monolith THX family.  .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}5 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind this product with a 5 year replacement warranty, we offer a 45 day money back guarantee as well! This product features recyclable packaging that is simple to open, cost effective, with minimal waste, and fully protective as it travels to you.Service and SupportYou're never on your own with Monoprice products! Contact our technical support team for questions about our products, troubleshooting, or even suggestions for products to fit your particular needs.
